Metadata.description: Track every job application, interview and follow-up in one place.

Home.intro: Save every application, see where each one stands, and get a reminder when it's time to follow up.

board.title: Every application on one board
board.body: From applied to offer, see your whole search at a glance.

reminders.title: Never forget a follow-up
reminders.body: A morning email tells you who to follow up with today.

insights.title: Learn what works
insights.body: See which sources get you interviews and how fast companies reply.

NotFound.title: Page not found
NotFound.body: The page you're looking for doesn't exist.

register.title: Create your account
register.description: Free. Start tracking your applications in a minute.

forgot.title: Reset your password
forgot.description: Enter your email and we'll send you a link to set a new password.
forgot.sent: If an account uses that email, a link to reset the password is on its way. It works for 30 minutes.

reset.title: Set a new password
reset.description: Choose a new password for your account.
reset.done: Your password is changed. Log in with the new one.
reset.noToken: This link is incomplete. Open the link from the email again, or ask for a new one.

verify.title: Confirm your email
verify.done: Your email is confirmed. Thank you!
verify.noToken: This link is incomplete. Open the link from the email again.

google.unavailable: Google sign-in couldn't load. Use your email and password instead, or try again later.

Errors.invalid_credentials: That email and password don't match.
Errors.email_taken: An account with this email already exists. Log in instead.
Errors.too_many_login_attempts: Too many attempts. Try again in {seconds} seconds.
Errors.too_many_reset_requests: Too many requests. Try again in {seconds} seconds.
Errors.too_many_emails: We've sent several emails already. Try again in {seconds} seconds.
Errors.invalid_google_token: Google sign-in didn't work. Try again.
Errors.google_token_expired: The Google sign-in took too long. Try again.
Errors.google_email_not_verified: Google hasn't confirmed this account's email address, so we can't use it.
Errors.google_account_mismatch: This email's account is linked to a different Google account.
Errors.google_unavailable: We couldn't reach Google. Try again in a moment.
Errors.google_sign_in_not_configured: Google sign-in isn't available right now. Use your email and password.
Errors.invalid_verification_token: This link has already been used or isn't valid. Log in and ask for a new one.
Errors.verification_token_expired: This link has expired. Log in and ask for a new one.
Errors.invalid_reset_token: This link has already been used or isn't valid. Ask for a new one.
Errors.reset_token_expired: This link has expired. Ask for a new one.
Errors.validation_error: Check the fields and try again.
Errors.network: We can't reach the server. Check your connection and try again; the first request after a while can take up to a minute.
